verdict.rationale: The models page publishes explicit per-token prices for every model (e.g. "$42 / $0.042" per Btok/Mtok) with clear billing rules (input-only charging), plus a public GET /v1/models endpoint for programmatic discovery — all accessible without contacting sales, consistent with the self-serve Playground/API signup flow. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that pricing is indeed public and current (no third-party corroboration of the price table itself).
